items.title: 4.7 Limiting and excess reactant (kam parne wala aur zyada bachne wala reactant) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7, printed pages 85-86, with a tip and a self-check.

blocks.text: Aksar chemical processes mein reactants us ratio mein maujood nahi hote jo balanced equation batati hai. Bohat dafa sasta (inexpensive) reactant zyada amount (miqdar) mein dala jata hai, in wajah se:

items: Taake mehnga reactant poora ka poora desired (chahiye wala) product mein badal jaye
Taake zyada se zyada product bane
Taake reaction ki rate (raftar) barh jaye

blocks.text: Hum jante hain ke zyada oxygen ho to cheezein tezi se jalti hain. Is tarah reaction ke aakhir mein oxygen bach jati hai aur doosra reactant, yani fuel, pehle khatam ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Limiting reactant
blocks.text: Jo reactant pehle khatam (consume) ho jaye, use limiting reactant kehte hain.
Banne wale product ki amount usi reactant se limited (mehdood) hoti hai jo poora istemal ho jata hai. Jaise hi yeh reactant khatam hota hai, reaction ruk jata hai aur aur product nahi banta.

blocks.title: Limiting reactant ya reagent
blocks.text: Jo reactant reaction mein banne wale products ki amount ko control karta hai aur pehle khatam hota hai, woh limiting reactant ya reagent hai.
Zyada se zyada kitna product banega, yeh mixture mein limiting reactant ki amount par depend karta hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Sandwich ki misal: 10 bread slices aur 3 cheese slices hon to sirf 3 sandwich banenge. Cheese pehle khatam hui, woh limiting hai; bachi hui bread excess hai.

blocks.prompt: Aag par kambal daal kar use bujhaya jata hai. Limiting aur excess reactant ke lihaz se samjhayein ke aag kyun bujh jati hai.
blocks.explanation: Aag fuel aur oxygen ka reaction hai. Aam taur par oxygen zyada (excess) hoti hai. Kambal oxygen ki supply rok deta hai, to oxygen limiting reactant ban jati hai; woh khatam hote hi reaction ruk jata hai, chahe fuel baqi ho.

items: Sasta reactant zyada dala jata hai taake mehnga poora istemal ho, product zyada bane aur reaction tez ho.
Pehle khatam hone wala reactant limiting reactant hai; yahi tai karta hai ke zyada se zyada kitna product banega.
